SOLICITATION NO. EXAMPLE-26-R-0001 (SYNTHETIC SAMPLE)
Agency: Example Federal Agency, Office of Acquisition
Standard Form SF-1449 applies. Offerors shall sign and return SF 1449 and acknowledge all amendments on SF-30.

SECTION L - INSTRUCTIONS TO OFFERORS
L.1 Questions regarding this solicitation are due no later than October 20, 2026 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time.
L.2 Proposals are due by 11:00 AM EDT on November 5, 2026. Late proposals will not be considered.
L.3 A pre-proposal conference (site visit) will be held 10/27/2026 at 10:00 AM local time; registration is due by 10/23/2026.
L.4 The proposal shall consist of the following volumes:
  Volume I - Technical
  Volume II - Past Performance
  Volume III - Price
L.5 Volume I Technical shall not exceed twenty (20) pages.
L.6 Volume II Past Performance is limited to 10 pages.
L.7 Pages shall be 8.5 x 11 inches with 1-inch margins. Text shall use 12-point Times New Roman font, single-spaced.
L.8 Proposals must be submitted in PDF format by email.
L.9 The Offeror shall include its UEI and CAGE code on the cover page.
L.10 The Offeror shall complete the representations at FAR 52.212-3 and DFARS 252.204-7012 applies.

SECTION M - EVALUATION FACTORS
The Government will evaluate proposals in accordance with Section M.
